root_text:
HMPV is a respiratory virus spread by droplets or surfaces.

🚨 Symptoms:
Mild: Fever, cough, runny nose.
Severe: Breathing issues, pneumonia.
✅ Prevention:
• Wash hands
• Avoid touching face
• Cover coughs
🩺 See a doctor if needed. Stay saf
